verses.text: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
lines: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty,
ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
lines: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.
Worship Yahweh in holy array.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
lines: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters.
The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
lines: Yahweh’s voice is powerful.
Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
lines: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars.
Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.text: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
lines: He makes them also to skip like a calf;
Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
lines: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
lines: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness.
Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.text: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
lines: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve,
and strips the forests bare.
In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

verses.text: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
lines: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood.
Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

verses.text: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
lines: Yahweh will give strength to his people.
Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
